introHtml: Neon lanyards and badge holders make your staff or event attendees instantly recognizable in crowded venues, low-light environments, or outdoor settings. Unlike standard dark or pastel colors, neon shades like highlighter yellow, lime green, and hot pink command attention from across the room. Our 5/8" neon polyester lanyards offer a durable, lightweight option for conferences, festivals, or safety teams, and they pair well with screen-printed logos for bold, long-lasting visibility.
